map.输入轴壁聚合角、预备高度与基底直径，评估全冠或嵌体的固位形与抗力形，辅助牙体预备: Enter the axial wall taper, preparation height and base diameter to evaluate the retention and resistance form of a full crown or inlay, supporting tooth preparation.
map.全冠预备聚合角偏大，输入参数后工具提示固位下降并建议减小聚合角。: When the full-crown preparation taper is too large, the tool reports reduced retention and suggests a smaller taper.
map.预备高度不足，量化与最小固位高度差距，提示冠延长或桩核。: When preparation height is insufficient, it quantifies the gap to the minimum retention height and suggests crown lengthening or a post-and-core.
map.嵌体洞形评估抗力形，提示洞壁厚度与线角圆钝。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛参考: For inlay cavity form it evaluates the resistance form and indicates wall thickness and rounded internal line angles. map.：输入：轴壁聚合角 6°/侧（总 12°），预备高度 4mm，基底直径 5mm\:
Input: axial wall taper 6° per side (12° total), preparation height 4 mm, base diameter 5 mm.
Verdict: the taper and height fall within the acceptable range for conventional full-crown retention; if the total taper exceeds 20°, retention drops markedly.
map.聚合角为什么影响固位？: Why does the taper affect retention?
map.聚合角越大，轴壁越外敞，摩擦固位面积减小、冠易脱落；临床常控总聚合角 10~20: The larger the taper, the more the axial walls flare outward, reducing the frictional retention area and letting the crown dislodge. Clinically the total taper is usually kept at 10-20° to balance retention and seating.
map.预备高度不够怎么办？: What if the preparation height is too small?
map.可用冠延长术、桩核重建增加临床牙冠高度；过短会增加脱落风险，由修复科医师设计。: Crown lengthening or a post-and-core reconstruction can increase the clinical crown height. Too short a preparation raises dislodgement risk, and the design is made by a prosthodontist.
map.指修复体与基牙能承受咬合力而不折裂，要求洞壁有厚度、线角圆钝、无薄弱尖；具体以医: It means the restoration and the prepared tooth can withstand occlusal force without fracturing, which requires adequate cavity wall thickness, rounded internal line angles and no weak thin points. The actual preparation is decided by the dentist.
